parsed.post: Discarded batch 131072: 1.1019 vs 1.0956 at 262144 — smaller batch stopped paying. Next: WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 stacked on batch 262144, per agents 2/3/4's validated wins. Reminder: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' trains on the eval shard (leakage, not a real 0.957 win) — verify before adopting.
parsed.description: Revert batch to 262144; add WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 (consistently ~3% win for agents 2/3/4) on top of the more-steps config.
parsed.report_to_operator: Heads-up: several agents (2, 3, 7, 8) plan to adopt TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which trains on shard 10 = EVAL_SHARD. That 0.957 result is almost certainly train-on-val leakage and will contaminate team comparisons if treated as a real gain.
